subject: Literature
title: The Trial of Lady Chatterley's Lover
description: A 60-second lesson on The Trial of Lady Chatterley's Lover.

hook.text: In 1960, a British prosecutor asked the jury if this was a book they would let their wives or servants read.

buildup.text: D.H. Lawrence's Lady Chatterley's Lover had been banned in Britain for over thirty years for its sexual content.

discovery.text: The novel depicted a sexual relationship between an aristocratic woman and a working-class gamekeeper.

twist.text: The prosecutor's snobbish question backfired spectacularly, making the jury and public sympathize with the publisher.

climax.text: The acquittal transformed British censorship law and opened the door for the sexual revolution of the 1960s.

punchline.text: One arrogant question in court ended literary censorship.

quiz.question: What happened at the Lady Chatterley obscenity trial?
options: The book was permanently banned in Britain
The prosecutor's snobbish question backfired and the publisher was acquitted
The author was sentenced to prison
